entities.name: Vera Markovna Karelina
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vera Markovna Karelina was a Russian labour activist and revolutionary, one of the leaders of the Georgy Gapon's Assembly of Russian Factory and Mill Workers of St. Petersburg and the Bloody Sunday procession.
